items.html: *Also know that this Dalet upon the Vav, in the form of the first Hey, we already explained has a tip behind it, in the form of a Yud, which is the discernment of Yeshsut. Also know that this Dalet divides into three parts, which are a Yud in the middle and two Vavs drawn from it, thus, and they total twenty-two letters in Gematria, given from Chochma to Bina. Now a reason must be given why in the letter Yud, Bina is concealed and Chochma is revealed, and in the letter Hey, Bina is revealed and Chochma is concealed.
